verdict.rationale: three.js ships product surfaces where an assistant could plausibly live, such as the editor and docs site, so this axis applies to it. The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant users can delegate tasks to. The llms.txt files are machine-readable docs for external coding agents, an adjacent capability that earns no credit here, and the probe notes that coding agents drive the library directly through npm rather than through any in-product assistant.
